interventions.what: text screens read from DOSBox-X savestates (component Vga)
a savestate is written at each read (save of emulator state; neutrality not tested)
the start state loaded into a running DOSBox-X (a restore)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process; C: mounted from a copy of One-Nil 96's files (records/T01/inventory.json); 1-0 run to its title screen, a key, then the savestate loaded (driver.Driver.launch, the load key) and its screen digest awaited; host clock not controlled

keys: full-time screen of the watched match (any other key to exit): n
